module purpose: neorv32_uart is a bus-attached UART: a control word written over bus_req_i is held in ctrl (enable, simulation mode, flow-control enable, prescaler select, baud divisor, interrupt enables, FIFO clear commands); bytes written to the data address are pushed into a TX FIFO sub-unit and serialized by a transmitter state machine onto uart_txd_o; bits sampled from uart_rxd_i are assembled by a receiver state machine and pushed into an RX FIFO sub-unit that the bus reads. It returns settings, status and the overrun flag on bus_rsp_o, honours CTS from uart_ctsn_i, drives RTS on uart_rtsn_o, raises irq_rx_o and irq_tx_o, and exports the enable on clkgen_en_o.

use-case flows.value: control settings (enable, simulation mode, flow-control enable, prescaler select, baud divisor, interrupt enables) written from the bus into ctrl on a qualified write with addr(2)='0'
a transmit byte pushed into the TX FIFO on a qualified bus write to the data address, and the transmitter leaving idle when the FIFO has data and CTS permits
one-cycle FIFO clear commands written from the bus and turned into FIFO clear requests to the FIFO sub-units
bit-period timing: a tick selected from clkgen_i by the prescaler setting, and the baud divisor reloaded into the transmit and receive bit-period counters
transmit framing: the FIFO byte loaded with a start bit into the shift register, shifted out bit by bit under the bit-period and bit counters, and driven on uart_txd_o
receive framing: uart_rxd_i synchronized, start bit detected, bits shifted into the receive shift register, and the completed byte pushed into the RX FIFO
hardware flow control: CTS sampled and honoured before a frame starts; RTS driven from the enable and the RX FIFO fill level
interrupt requests from enabled FIFO conditions, the receive overrun flag, and FIFO and transmitter status bits returned in the control word
stored control settings and the received byte returned on a qualified bus read; the read of the data address pops the RX FIFO
control, engine, interrupt, overrun and RTS registers cleared while rstn_i is '0'; both FIFOs cleared while enable is '0', simulation mode is '1' or a clear command is set

conceptual assets.concept: UART enable -- whether the UART operates (FIFOs held clear, engines idle, interrupts suppressed when off), also exported to the clock generator
conceptual assets.reasoning: Configure flow: `ctrl.enable <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_en_c);` (line 179, CLOCKED_BY clk_i at occurrence 3) under stb, rw and addr(2)='0' (lines 176-178). Its own value is a decision the module depends on: '0' holds both FIFOs in clear (GATES tx_fifo.clear line 259, rx_fifo.clear line 304), it is copied into the engines' state MSB so they idle (COPIES at lines 344, 417), it clears the overrun flag (lines 458-459), gates both interrupt requests (lines 270, 315) and forces RTS (lines 473-475). Integrity is Established: these effects must follow the written value. `clkgen_en_o <= ctrl.enable;` (line 228, COPIES ctrl.enable at occurrence 2) delivers it to a clock generator outside this file, so the consumer must receive exactly ctrl.enable; clkgen_en_o is an exit port (an output that exports an enable is not excluded). Availability is also Established: held between writes, reset to '0' at line 156. Confidentiality is not established: line 195 returns it on any qualified read.

conceptual assets.concept: Simulation-mode setting -- holds both FIFOs in clear and routes transmit-data writes to a simulation log, in builds where sim_mode_en_c holds
conceptual assets.reasoning: `ctrl.sim_mode <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_sim_en_c) and bool_to_ulogic_f(sim_mode_en_c);` (line 180, CLOCKED_BY clk_i at occurrence 3). Condition: sim_mode_en_c is SIM_MODE_EN and is_simulation_c (line 50); when it is false the register can only take '0', and the sim_tx process exists only under `if sim_mode_en_c generate` (lines 490-491). Where the condition holds, '1' holds both FIFOs in clear (GATES tx_fifo.clear line 259, rx_fifo.clear line 304) and, with ctrl.enable, sends bus data writes to the simulation output (lines 499-511) instead of the transmitter. Integrity is Established for those builds: whether written bytes are transmitted and whether buffered bytes survive depends on this stored setting. The map carries no configuration record for it; the condition is read from lines 50 and 180.

conceptual assets.reasoning: `ctrl.prsc <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_prsc2_c downto ctrl_prsc0_c);` (line 182) and `ctrl.baud <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_baud9_c downto ctrl_baud0_c);` (line 183) store the setting (CLOCKED_BY clk_i at occurrence 3 each). ctrl.prsc selects the tick `uart_clk <= clkgen_i(to_integer(unsigned(ctrl.prsc)));` (line 229, SELECTS uart_clk); ctrl.baud reloads the transmit and receive bit-period counters (CARRIES at lines 349, 368, 432; SOURCES at line 422). conceptual assets.concept: Ready-to-receive indication (RTS) driven to the remote sender
conceptual assets.reasoning: rtr_control decides it: with ctrl.hwfc_en='1', uart_rtsn_o is '1' when ctrl.enable='0' or rx_fifo.half='1' and '0' otherwise; with ctrl.hwfc_en='0' it is '0' (lines 472-480). uart_rtsn_o is a registered output (CLOCKED_BY clk_i at occurrences 3-5) and the exit port (GATED_BY ctrl.hwfc_en at occurrence 3, line 475): the decision is delivered to a device outside this file, so it must equal the value lines 472-480 define. Not reported: bus_req_i.data is a field of the transport record; tx_fifo.wdata and tx_fifo.rdata only pass the byte unchanged to and from the FIFO sub-unit (carriers).
